# Part III: The Runtime Embodied Stack {.unnumbered}

Building a physical AI machine is fundamentally an exercise in **reconciling disparate timescales and representations**.

No single algorithm, model, or hardware core can span the vast continuum between high-level reasoning and low-level physical dynamics. At the highest level, human goals and task semantics are symbolic and linguistic, evolving over seconds. In the middle, physical space is volumetric and continuous, requiring 3D spatial representations and smooth kinematic trajectories generated at tens of hertz. At the lowest level, motor torque control is electromagnetic and immediate, demanding cycle-deterministic execution at kilohertz frequencies to prevent mechanical instability.

Part III details the complete runtime architecture that transforms raw physical sensor photons into coordinated motor currents:

* **From Photons to Spatial Belief:** How raw, uncompressed sensor streams from SerDes lanes are ingested, calibrated, and fused into durable 3D spatial representations ($SE(3)$ transform trees, TSDF voxel grids, 3D Gaussian Splats) that persist even through dynamic occlusions.
* **From Grounded Intent to Motion:** How high-level semantic intent is grounded into reachable physical goals, and how continuous planning models generate smooth, jerk-bounded action chunks across receding planning horizons.
* **From Action Proposals to Physical Force:** How candidate trajectories pass through microsecond-scale invariant enforcers and Control Barrier Functions on dedicated real-time silicon before any power stage is energized.
* **The Silicon Substrate:** How these multi-rate subsystems co-exist on shared heterogeneous System-on-Chip (SoC) architectures—isolating memory crossbars, preventing DRAM bank contention, and managing power delivery network ($L \frac{dI}{dt}$) voltage droop.

A physical AI runtime is not a loose collection of independent scripts. It is a tightly synchronized, multi-rate systems pipeline engineered to keep high-level intelligence grounded in physical reality.
